NFV Proof Coverage Map

A zoomable map of the Z3 src/ tree, mined from every NFV Formal Audit report published so far. Click a folder to zoom in, use the breadcrumb to zoom back out. Files are colored by the strongest proof evidence a Dafny audit ever produced for a property postulated on that file: green for a property Dafny proved, amber for an audited file with no proof. A small red dot marks a file or folder containing a property Dafny refuted, without changing its coverage color. Hover a tile for refutation counts and, on files, the established properties. Click any file tile (not a folder) to open a summary of that file's functions and their proved/refuted/abstained properties.
